title: Meet 4lpha - Testers Needed
author: LiteSaber
selftext:
Download Free for Windows / MacOS / Linux - Early build but fully functional with both paper and live trading.

I'd love for you guys to try it out and give some feedback. I already have a huge list of updates I'm working through, but I could always use some more eyes on to see what you find and what ideas you have to improve the app overall.

🙏

[http://4lpha.si/](http://4lpha.si/)

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: does the paper side fill at the same price the live side would? that's where early builds drift, paper fills at the last print and live pays the spread.

replies.author: LiteSaber
replies.body: Right now the paper fills emulating a spread, but I have some more improvements to do there as I want it to be even closer to live trading. Update for that coming real soon.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: a flat spread is a decent start. where it bit me was the open and the close, spreads there run a lot wider than midday, so one fixed number flatters anything that trades the first fifteen minutes.

replies.author: LiteSaber
replies.body:
v0.1.6 is now out with some fixes specific to your request

**What changes**

* **Entries pay the real spread.** Market orders used to fill at the mid, the halfway point between buyers and sellers, which is better than you’d ever get live. Now they read Hyperliquid’s real order book: buys fill at the ask, sells at the bid. A bigger order walks through more of the book and gets a worse average price (slippage), just like live.
* **Limits fill whenever price touches them.** A resting limit now fills at your exact price, with the cheaper maker fee, as soon as a trade, the best bid/ask, or a candle wick reaches it. The candle check means anything you can see on the chart, the app sees too.
* **Likely cause of the missed fills:** the old trade check went by your PC’s clock. If the clock was even slightly ahead of Hyperliquid’s, it could ignore real trades just after you placed an order. It now uses Hyperliquid’s own time.
* **Stops fill like live.** They fire on the mark price, as before, but now fill at the real bid/ask instead of the trigger price. Fees match what a live trade would pay.

  
For the next update ill be focusing on upgrading the server script i have running so that it gets more history and better detail for the heatmaps/orderbook history. The app downloads this data from my server when you open any chart. It then pulls live directly to your app from hyperliquid (and several other exchanges to be better informed).

replies.author: LiteSaber
replies.body: It will stay free to download. It has builder codes in it. I've set them super low as to not be a turn off for people and you shouldn't really notice. I just enjoy building this stuff and I'm using it to trade already, so ill keep it updated as I and others come up with improvements.
